mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals monetary easing, lowering discount rates applied to equity cash flows and compressing forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns fail to outperform a baseline model (p > 0.05 in t-test) during periods of FEDFUNDS decline.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.0) triggers Fed rate hikes, reducing growth expectations and equity valuations, leading to negative 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns remain positive despite CPIAUCSL exceeding 2.0, or the threshold isn't sustained.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises alongside falling unemployment (UNRATE < 6.5%), conflicting signals of tightening policy lead to negative 60-day forward returns as investors anticipate economic slowdown.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are positive despite the interaction of FEDFUNDS >4% and UNRATE <6.5%, or the proxies don't co-occur.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a sustained drop in INDPRO signals overcapacity and peak concerns, prompting investors to sell, resulting in negative 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns remain positive during late-cycle expansions despite INDPRO decline, or the decline isn't sustained.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in demand (GDPC1 > 12,000) coupled with a contraction in supply (INDPRO < 95.0) creates an overheating economy, leading to negative 20-day forward returns as valuations are overvalued.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive despite the interaction of GDPC1 >12k and INDPRO <95, or the proxies don't co-occur.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in UNRATE (unemployment falling >6.5%) triggers expectations of inflation, prompting Fed rate hikes and negative equity returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns remain positive despite UNRATE crossing 6.5%, or the rise isn't sustained.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in employment (PAYEMS) signals a robust labor market, boosting consumer confidence and equity valuations, leading to positive 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 5-day returns fail to outperform a baseline model (p > 0.05 in t-test) during periods of PAYEMS growth.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises alongside a surge in demand (HOUST > 650), conflicting signals of tightening policy lead to negative 60-day forward returns as investors anticipate economic slowdown.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are positive despite the interaction of FEDFUNDS >4% and HOUST >650, or the proxies don't co-occur.
